ticket.subject: Data access request
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

Under GDPR Article 15, I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me.

I used your app through my former employer, Hollowfen Media. Please include where the data came from and who it was shared with.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Let me know if you need anything to verify my identity.

Many thanks,
Priya Haddad

label_notes: clean privacy (privacy-dsar-access): a data access request is privacy; the legal deadline is weeks away, so P3; urgency medium: action needed this week.
